verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a corporate card and spend platform. Its API can query travel transactions, and spend platforms can plausibly offer travel booking, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents monitoring booked travel rates or automatically rebooking when prices drop. Querying travel transactions is reporting on past spend, not price monitoring or rebooking.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
